summary: Gap redemption batch built from the 2026-09-10 dig report (.zcode/kb-gap-dig-2026-09-10.md) and candidates 01-05. v11 adds six active entries closing five uncovered signals: a continuous-braking training cue carrying linearity high plus both decel_frac signals, a two-phase peak-position interpretation carrying peak_position low/high, a wide-wall speed progression for peak_speed below reference, a predictable-path control cue for accuracy low, an external-cause checklist for avg error high, and a revived path-directness entry for path_efficiency low merged from registry.v1's metric and cue entries. hypothesis.tension-management moves to @6 by wiring in the ptc high signal plus the metric:ptc reference, and community.overshoot-sensitivity-trigger moves to @2 by wiring in the sensitivity high signal; in both upgrades every other field is byte-identical to v10. All 27 v10 corpus sources get their Bilibili publish dates backfilled from the 2026-09-10 pubdate research. Seventeen sources are added: fourteen Bilibili transcripts cited by the candidates and three academic revivals (Woodworth 1899, Becker 2020, Flash and Hogan 1985) backing the revived model-boundary sections. Community paraphrase stays at or below community_practice; revived academic sections stay research_supported; body-adjacent content defers to the ergonomics entries and every stop rule carries the medical red line. schema_version, the signal_aliases map, all capability prefixes, the other 43 v10 entries, and every v10 entry_version other than the two upgrades are unchanged, and v10 remains loadable as history.

capability_discipline.body_content_ceiling: body-adjacent content stays an experimental candidate hypothesis and defers to the ergonomics entries; no entry claims posture, compensation, or sensor state is measured by Aiming Cookie data
capability_discipline.medical_red_line: Persistent pain, numbness, or weakness stops training immediately and is referred to a doctor or rehabilitation professional.
capability_discipline.community_paraphrase_ceiling: community_practice (x76 wiki and Bilibili coach corpus sections never exceed community_practice)
capability_discipline.revival_claim_levels: revived v1 academic material stays research_supported and product-contract material stays deterministic_rule

added_entries.note: Continuous braking cue reviving v1 cue.flicking.continuous-braking with the braking-linearity definition and the Flash-Hogan model boundary folded in; carries linearity high plus decel_frac high/low so the two half-connected decel signals gain a content anchor.

Two-phase movement-timing interpretation carrying peak_position low/high; the reading leans on the community two-phase model plus revived product-contract and Woodworth/Becker academic sections, and says so in limitations.

Speed-supply progression for peak_speed below reference: wide-travel scenarios force the speed, a ninety-percent pressure ruler bounds the accuracy cost, and pushing pace is decoupled from throwing harder.
Result-layer cue for accuracy low on readable paths: constant-path control practice, three-band form specialization, strategy-before-strength attribution, de-branded scenario shapes.

External-cause checklist for avg error high with three independent chains (arc accumulation and recentering, postural default offset, sensor skew); posture content only points at the ergonomics entries and the analyzer is explicitly said not to distinguish the causes.
Zero-corpus-increment revival accepted by the decision: product-contract definition plus the voltaic directness cue merged into one entry carrying path_efficiency low.

upgraded_entries.unchanged_invariants: definition, scope, expected_direction, all mechanisms, cue, dose_guardrail, matched_retest, stop_adjust_rule, alternative_explanations, forbidden_inferences, limitations, counterevidence, sources, family_scope, observation_refs, quality_prerequisites, topics, and supported_uses are byte-identical to @5.
upgraded_entries.note: Closes the B6 wiring gap: agent fetch_knowledge matches signals only, so metric_refs alone cannot serve the ptc high finding; v1 precedent hypothesis.tension.tracking carried the same signal.

upgraded_entries.unchanged_invariants: metric_refs and every other field are byte-identical to @1.
upgraded_entries.note: Closes the B7 wiring gap: the analyzer's sensitivity-high trigger has no entry coverage; the overshoot trigger is the one neighbor whose definition, structure, and prescription all match the fast-side reading.

audited_unchanged.note: entry_id, entry_version, and every section are carried over byte-identical from v10; signal_aliases and the existing 75 sources are untouched except for the 27 published_at backfills declared above.
schema_version stays coach_knowledge_registry.v3; both the Python and TypeScript loaders register 2026-09-10.v11 as the packaged default and keep every historical version loadable by exact version.
